# Deepgram Connector for Muse

A Muse agent skill for Deepgram's speech AI: transcribe prerecorded audio (wav, mp3, m4a, flac, ogg) to text with speaker diarization, summaries, topics, and sentiment; or synthesize speech with Aura voices (2,000 characters per request). Honest note: usage is metered — transcription is billed by audio duration and TTS by characters, and new Deepgram accounts include free credits to try it; the skill confirms before transcribing large batches. Private-audio warning: think before uploading sensitive recordings — transcription sends your audio to Deepgram's servers. Draft: written from Deepgram's public API docs, not yet live-tested end-to-end — this listing's unverified status reflects that. No secrets in the repo.
